shared_elements: horizontal or rectangular band with repeated linear/angled pattern
incised/low-relief decoration on a vertical stone surface
justification: The most specific correspondence is the presence of profile animal/bird-like forms combined with small circular eye/disc details and a patterned horizontal/rectangular band near the upper part of the carved surface. The biggest difference is that A is a clear, organized multi-register relief covering the slab, while B is a damaged, monochrome fragment with decoration concentrated mainly along one side and with much less legible imagery.
